PeakddThe systematic flux calibration uncertainty of 6% is not included.

record.status: Ignored targeted primary interpretation preparation; no production change
findings: Uniform-brightness fitting may underestimate mean physical size by approximately 2–4 percent according to the authors. Detailed shape comparison requires thermal modelling; no catalogue size or shape adopted.

DAMIT comparison uses artificial illumination and a publisher 16.4-minute light-time correction. ALMA major axes approximately 6 percent smaller than model maxima are within quoted 12 percent model-scale uncertainty. Qualitative discrepancies do not establish registered geography.

Residual images subtract a uniform template derived from CLEAN-component medians and convolve with a 42mas beam. Figure3 residuals of approximately ±30K are relative to a median, not absolute visible colour, local composition or directly measured regolith kinetic temperature.

Thermal discussion assumes Bond albedo .09 and combines distinct optical/infrared inputs. Equilibrium 188–223K and STM 286K versus observed maximum 222±13K depend on rotation, beaming and emissivity assumptions. Effective emissivity near .8 can include subsurface sounding; no unique local emissivity or thermal profile measured.

Illustrative thermal inertia46 and skin depth2.8mm use borrowed Vesta regolith density and porous lunar conductivity/heat capacity. These are analogue-dependent model inputs, not Juno local density, chemistry, porosity or skin-depth measurements; no analogue imagery or skin reuse permitted.

Longitude-dependent thermal-inertia interpretation assumes constant conductivity. Density/heat-capacity variations and comparisons with other asteroids remain interpretations, not measured local fractions or maps.

Association of a putative adaptive-optics crater depends on an unspecified north/south orientation in an earlier reconstruction. Neither crater location nor impact history registered to the ALMA still.

Authors call for future complete-rotation, multi-phase and multiwavelength thermophysical modelling. Future 2018 resolution forecasts are not new observations. Acknowledged dataset identifier ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00013.SV is not an independently verified still-to-raw-product crosswalk.
